rag.text:
Test: TC-530 — Global - Holiday plans - Editing holiday plans synchronized with Tempo
Priority: Medium | Status: Done | Type: Manual
Folder: /BP/TS-26 Global - Holiday plans
Labels: be-enterprise

Steps:
1. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Holidays
   Data: _Tempo_ should be installed
   Expected: Holidays tab is displayed
2. Add new Holiday plan passing this set of data
   Data: name: TC-530 Holiday Plan to edit
   Expected: Holiday plan is added
3. Navigate to BP Administration -> Holiday plans tab and click Synchronize with Tempo button
   Expected: "TC-530 Holiday Plan to edit" is displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge.
4. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Holidays
   Expected: Holidays tab is displayed
5. Click on name of holidayScheme and set newName
   Data: holidayScheme: TC-530 Holiday Plan to edit
newName: TC-530 Holiday Plan edited
   Expected: Changes are saved
6. Navigate to BP Administration -> Holiday plans tab
   Expected: Holiday plans tab is displayed

"TC-530 Holiday Plan to edit" is still displayed on the list.
7. Click Synchronize with Tempo and check visibility after refresh
   Expected: "TC-530 Holiday Plan edited" is now displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge.
8. Click on Edit button next to holidayPlanName and set newName and description
   Data: holidayPlanName: TC-530 Holiday Plan edited
newName: TC-530 Holiday Plan edited on BP level
   Expected: Changes are saved.

Holiday plan synchronized from Tempo is overwrited in BP level. Blue pencil icon is displayed next to holiday plan name.
9. Navigate to Tempo -> Settings -> Holidays
   Expected: Holidays tab is displayed

"TC-530 Holiday Plan edited" is still displayed on the list. Changes made in BP level are not visible in Tempo.
10. Click on name of holidayScheme and set newName
   Data: holidayScheme: TC-530 Holiday Plan edited
newName: TC-530 Holiday Plan 2
   Expected: Changes are saved
11. Navigate to BP Administration -> Holiday plans tab and click Synchronize with Tempo button

Check visibility after refresh
   Expected: "TC-530 Holiday Plan edited on BP level" is still displayed on the list with green Tempo lozenge.

Changes made in Tempo are not visible in BP Administration after overwrite Holiday Plan in step 8.
